description:
Ø Master Production Scheduling & Synchronization:
· Develop and maintain the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and detailed shop floor schedules.
· Plan and sequence production orders across all divisions to ensure synchronized flow, particularly for multi-material products (e.g., Upholstery + Metal Frame + Solid Wood), achieving simultaneous convergence at the packaging line.
· Monitor real-time production progress, identify bottlenecks, and execute dynamic scheduling adjustments to meet targets.
Ø Material Requirements Planning & Global Logistics Coordination:
· Execute precise Material Requirements Planning (MRP) to determine material needs.
· Collaborate closely with the sister Trading Company in China to establish and maintain an accurate phased-delivery schedule for imported materials, aligning seamlessly with the production plan.
· Proactively monitor raw material inventory, in-transit status, and consumption patterns.
Ø Inventory & Flow Optimization:
· Implement and lead WIP reduction initiatives to streamline flow between workshops.
· Manage overall inventory levels (Raw Materials, WIP, Finished Goods) with a focus on significantly improving inventory turnover rates.
· Oversee cycle counts and physical inventory audits.
Ø Department Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration:
· Lead, mentor, and develop the PMC team..
· Serve as the primary liaison between Procurement, Quality, Warehouse, Production Divisions, and the external Trading Partner.
· Lead daily/weekly production and material review meetings to ensure alignment and rapid issue resolution.
Ø Process Improvement & Systems Management:
· Continuously improve planning, scheduling, and inventory control processes.
· Leverage the ERP system (e.g., SAP, Oracle) to its full potential for data integrity and planning efficiency.
· Analyze KPIs (On-Time Delivery, Schedule Attainment, Inventory Turnover) and drive continuous improvement projects.
requirements_text:
Required qualifications
· Minimum Academic Requirement: College degree or above in engineering or management.
· Bachelor's degree or higher in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
Required working experience
· Minimum of 5 years of proven experience in a PMC/Supply Chain management role, with at least 3 years in a large-scale, complex manufacturing environment (e.g., Furniture, Garmen, Automotive, Electronics, Appliances).
Required Languages
* Fluent in English (both written and spoken)
Required knowledge and skills
· Demonstrable expertise in managing production synchronization for products with complex Bills of Materials (BOM) across multiple production lines or workshops.
· Strong experience in international supply chain coordination, particularly with Chinese suppliers. Experience with phased deliveries is a plus.
· High proficiency in MRP/MPS principles and hands-on experience with a major ERP system (SAP is highly preferred).
· Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
· Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work under pressure in a multicultural setting.
· Preferred: Experience with Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma methodologies.
· Strong interpersonal skills and execution ability in planning.
· Clear logical thinking, ability to collect, organize, and analyze data and build a planning database; sensitive to numbers with the ability to detect production data anomalies in time.
· Strong coordination and communication skills; able to handle unexpected anomalies promptly and effectively.
